startups.name: 50 Startups Dataset
startups.title: 50 Startups Multiple Linear Regression Explorer
startups.description: Compare 5 Machine Learning Feature Selection Algorithms (Lasso, Forward SFS, RFE, ElasticNet, Exhaustive Search) against Baseline OLS. Explore the bias-variance tradeoff across feature counts k=1 ... 5, pinpointing the 2-feature optimal sweet spot and the 5-feature overfitting cliff.
startups.parsimony_text: Occam's Razor: 2 features yield the minimum test RMSE ($8,198.80) and peak R² (0.9474).

housing.name: Boston Housing Dataset
housing.title: Boston Housing Multiple Linear Regression Explorer
housing.description: Boston Housing 房地產價格多元線性迴歸分析 (MEDV: 業主自住房屋中位價格，單位千美元)。比較 5 種機器學習特徵選取演算法 (Lasso, Forward SFS, RFE, ElasticNet, Exhaustive Search) 在 13 個城鎮統計特徵中的篩選表現與偏誤-變異權衡 (Bias-Variance Tradeoff)。
housing.sweet_spot_text: Optimal Sweet Spot: k=5 (Min Test RMSE)
housing.parsimony_text: Occam's Razor: 5 features (ZN, NOX, DIS, PTRATIO, LSTAT) minimize test RMSE to 4.85k with R² of 0.679.
